title: Friendly service with recurring wait-time complaints

reviews.text: Friendly kaayo ang staff, pero dugay mi naghulat sa food.
The crew was welcoming and helpful, but service took almost an hour.
Maabiabihon ang mga staff ug lami ang ginabot.
Masarap ang pagkain pero napakatagal dumating.
Kind staff and tasty local food. We would return.
Dugay ang serving during lunch, although buotan ang crew.

expected_facts: Staff are repeatedly described as friendly, kind, welcoming, or helpful.
Several reviews mention slow service or a long wait.
Food receives positive comments, including the local term ginabot.

title: Clean dining area and good value with a restroom concern

reviews.text: Limpyo ang dining area ug sulit ang ilang meals.
Clean tables, generous portions, and affordable prices.
Sulit kaayo ang presyo and the serving was generous.
Malinis ang kainan pero kailangan linisin ang restroom.
Affordable food and a clean, comfortable dining space.
Okay ang meal, pero hugaw ug baho ang kasilyas.

expected_facts: The dining area is repeatedly described as clean.
Several reviewers consider the food affordable or good value.
Two reviews raise a restroom-cleanliness concern.
forbidden_claims: The business has an ocean view.
